endpoints.description: Query data within a route (e.g. electricity, petroleum, natural-gas) with facets
Discover child routes, facets, and data columns for a route

limits.notes: Free key required. Max 5,000 rows per request (use length/offset to page). No widely documented daily cap; respect 429s.

llmDocs.summary: US energy statistics: electricity prices/generation, petroleum, natural gas, coal, renewables, CO2 emissions, international energy. Hierarchical v2 API navigated by route + facets.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Explore the route tree first (GET /v2/{route}?api_key= lists child routes and facets). Then GET /v2/{route}/data/?api_key=&frequency=&data[]=value&facets[stateid][]=CA&start=&end=&length=. data[] selects metric columns; facets[] filters dimensions.

exampleQueries.intent: Monthly residential electricity price for California

gotchas: v2 is route-navigated, not series-id based like v1; you must discover routes/facets/data columns before querying.
data[] (metric columns) and facets[] (filter dimensions) are different param families — mixing them up returns empty data.
5,000-row request cap; paginate with length and offset.
Legacy v1 series-ID endpoints are deprecated — use v2.

compliance.redistributionNotes: Public domain US government data; attribution to EIA requested.
